title: Transport of an external Cech bidegree pairing to the ordinary cup
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ scheme morphisms. Let $U:I\to\operatorname{Opens}(X)$ and $V:J\to\operatorname{Opens}(Y)$ be arbitrary families, and let $F,G$ be modules on $X,Y$. Write $P=X\times_kY$, $W_{ij}=\operatorname{pr}_1^{-1}U_i\cap\operatorname{pr}_2^{-1}V_j$, $F'=\operatorname{pr}_1^*F$, $G'=\operatorname{pr}_2^*G$ and $E=F'\otimes G'$, using [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models]. For any scalar Cech complex of a module $M$, let $e_M$ be the additive cochain isomorphism to its ordinary module Cech complex obtained by composing the scalar and ordinary identifications with the explicit additive intersection complex. Fix $p,q\in\mathbb N$ and a map $h:C^p_k(U,F)\otimes_k C^q_k(V,G)\to C^{p+q}_k(W,E)$ satisfying the external front/back coordinates [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-bidegree]. Let $\gamma_F:C^\bullet(U,F)\to C^\bullet(W,F')$ and $\gamma_G:C^\bullet(V,G)\to C^\bullet(W,G')$ be any additive cochain maps satisfying [def-sc-cech-refinement-cochain-map] for the projections, the index maps $(i,j)\mapsto i$ and $(i,j)\mapsto j$, and the inclusions of $W_{ij}$ in the respective inverse images. Then for arbitrary cochains $a,b$, one has $e_E^{p+q}(h(a\otimes b))=\gamma_F^p(e_F^p(a))\cup\gamma_G^q(e_G^q(b))$, where the ordinary cup is [def-sc-cech-cup-product]. No cycle, covering, finiteness, separatedness or quasi-coherence hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Compose the scalar and ordinary cechComplexFunctorIso identifications, the second inversely, to define e_M. The scalar and ordinary presheaves have identical underlying additive section groups. Its coordinate equation is AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply. The differential equation is the cochain-map commutation equation, and equality of degree transports follows by substituting the degree equality.

Apply injectivity of the ordinary target Cech coordinate equivalence and evaluate at any tuple of length p+q+1. The scalar coordinate equation and the prescribed external bidegree formula express the left side as the tensor of the pulled front and back sections, restricted to the full product intersection.

Unfold the ordinary cup on the right and apply the two assumed refinement coordinate equations. The scalar coordinate equations identify the original factor sections with those on the left. For each factor, the two successive restrictions equal the single restriction to the full intersection by Functor.map_comp and uniqueness of morphisms between opens. Thus both tensor factors, every coordinate and the cochains agree. At p=0 or q=0 the front/back maps still have their common vertex; empty families have no tuples; zero modules and characteristic two need no extra calculation.

theorem picardExternalCechCupBidegree_transport
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (p q : ℕ)
    (h : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj
          (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + q))
    (hh : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p q h)
    (hrefineF : ∀ ij : ι × κ,
      (pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2) ≤
        pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1)
    (hrefineG : ∀ ij : ι × κ,
      (pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2) ≤
        pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)
    (gammaF : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{w} Γ(X, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{w}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat) ⟶
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{w} Γ(Limits.pullback f g, ⊤))
        AddCommGrpCat.{w}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
        ((cechComplexFunctor (fun ij : ι × κ ↦
          pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
          ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F).presheafModuleCat))
    (hgammaF : IsCechRefinementMap (pullback.fst f g) U
      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
        pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2) Prod.fst hrefineF F gammaF)
    (gammaG : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{w} Γ(Y, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{w}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj ((cechComplexFunctor V).obj G.presheafModuleCat) ⟶
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{w} Γ(Limits.pullback f g, ⊤))
        AddCommGrpCat.{w}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
        ((cechComplexFunctor (fun ij : ι × κ ↦
          pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
          ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G).presheafModuleCat))
    (hgammaG : IsCechRefinementMap (pullback.snd f g) V
      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
        pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2) Prod.snd hrefineG G gammaG) :
    let A := (picardCechFunctor f U).obj F
    let B := (picardCechFunctor g V).obj G
    let W := fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
      pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2
    let E := externalCupCoefficients f g F G
    ∀ (a : A.X p) (b : B.X q),
      (picardCechScalarIso (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) W E).hom.f (p + q)
        (h (a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) =
      cechCupCochain W ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F)
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) p q
        (gammaF.f p ((picardCechScalarIso f U F).hom.f p a))
        (gammaG.f q ((picardCechScalarIso g V G).hom.f q b))
